exposure: length of active second stage of birth
finding: While cross-sectional analysis showed conflicting results, matched pair analysis showed that episiotomy was associated with a lower incidence of OASIS in first vaginal births and a higher incidence in second or subsequent births, suggesting confounding by indication.
mod_finding: Matched pair analysis showed that episiotomy was associated with a lower incidence of OASIS in first vaginal births and a higher incidence in second or subsequent births.
